items.title: A universal property of the flattening ideal for finite type algebras

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades the characterisation of the flattening ideal to a universal property when the algebra is of finite type over the Noetherian base: a local base change satisfies the flat-at-primes condition exactly when the flattening ideal dies. One implication is quoted from the base change result for that condition. For the other, the author writes the Noetherian target as a directed colimit of local subalgebras essentially of finite type over the base, uses the limit-preserving result to move the flat-at-primes condition down to one of those subalgebras, applies the finite type version of the characterisation to that subalgebra, and concludes that the flattening ideal already dies there, hence also in the target.
